test_RPN: test the RPN proposal generator with standard anchors and verify expected classification and localization losses
test_RRPN: test the rotated RPN proposal generator with rotated anchors and verify expected losses and proposal boxes
test_find_top_rpn_proposals: test find_top_rpn_proposals to select top proposals by objectness logits and handle inf values
test_add_ground_truth_to_proposals: test add_ground_truth_to_proposals to append ground truth boxes to existing proposal instances
test_RPN_scriptability: test that the RPN proposal generator can be scripted with TorchScript and produces identical outputs
